diagnostic.root_cause: Remaining tracking error dominated by helix entry (gate-7, 0.394m) and sharp turns (gates 3, 4) where the controller hits its 0.7 rad tilt limit. The virtual finish waypoint eliminated gate-12's 2x error. Controller gains helped turns but tilt saturation caps further improvement.
architectural_issues: Controller tilt limit (0.7 rad) prevents more aggressive turn tracking — may need to increase or switch to SE(3) geometric tracker
Gate-11 slight regression (+0.024m) from trajectory time redistribution with added segment
Race time increased 16.41→16.97s due to extra trajectory segment — need speed optimization
critic_findings: Virtual finish waypoint adds ~0.9s to trajectory time, causing slight race time increase
Double-waypoint approach from 'On Your Own' could be applied to ALL gates for better smoothness

improvements_backlog.description: Apply double-waypoint (entry/exit) approach to all gates, not just the finish
improvements_backlog.proposed_approach: Per 'On Your Own' (Romero 2025): place waypoints at ±0.4m along each gate normal. This smooths the trajectory through gates and reduces turn sharpness.
improvements_backlog.expected_impact: Smoother turns → gate-7 error 0.39→0.30m, gates 3,4 error reduction ~0.03m each

improvements_backlog.description: Reduce race completion time from 16.97s toward 14s target
improvements_backlog.proposed_approach: Increase speed factors in time allocation after double-waypoint smoothing provides margin. Target 0.70-0.75 speed factor.

improvements_backlog.description: Increase max tilt limit from 0.7 rad to allow more aggressive turns
improvements_backlog.proposed_approach: Increase max_tilt_angle in DroneConstraints and controller tilt clamp. Test with 0.8 rad.
improvements_backlog.expected_impact: Turn gate errors could reduce further if trajectory demands more tilt

improvements_backlog.description: Install gym-pybullet-drones and enable PyBullet benchmark path
improvements_backlog.proposed_approach: pip install gym-pybullet-drones, enable simulation section in benchmark
improvements_backlog.expected_impact: More realistic benchmarking with real physics

improvements_backlog.description: Integrate GateTracker/GatePnP/EKF into runner for perception filtering
improvements_backlog.proposed_approach: Port perception modules from race_pipeline.py into sim_pybullet runner
improvements_backlog.expected_impact: Eliminate raw detection target jumps in PyBullet sim

failed_approaches.description: Increased max_velocity from 10.0 to 12.0 AND initial time allocation from 0.6 to 0.7 simultaneously. Trajectory became too aggressive for kinematic sim PD controller — max tracking error jumped to 6.4m and gate pass rate dropped to 67%.
failed_approaches.lesson: Match trajectory aggressiveness to controller capability. Change one parameter at a time.

failed_approaches.description: Curvature-aware initial time allocation had no measurable impact because L-BFGS optimizer in _optimize_time_allocation re-optimizes times regardless of initial guess.
failed_approaches.lesson: Initial time allocation heuristic matters less than the optimizer that runs after it. Focus on optimizer constraints or objective function changes rather than initialization.
failed_approaches.metrics_delta: No measurable change in any metric
